message.logos_dimension.missing_dimensio: The Crucible dimension is unavailable. Check the installation and world data.
message.logos_dimension.return_gate: Return vortex: %s, %s, %s. Right-click to return to your entrance cauldron.
message.logos_dimension.gate.unstable: Unstable mana cannot be poured into a gatestone
message.logos_dimension.gate.no_frame: The frame is not closed: the gatestone needs an opening above it, enclosed by blocks (at least two tall, 128 cells at most)
message.logos_dimension.gate.wrong_dimen: A gate only opens in the Overworld and the Journey continent
message.logos_dimension.unbound_cauldron: Unbound: jump in to create its dimension.
message.logos_dimension.use_cauldron: Jump into a cauldron to enter its bound world. Vortices are return exits only.
message.logos_dimension.natures_force.no: Not enough mana (requires %s); firing a stage II arrow
message.logos_dimension.elf_spear.old_lo: This Logos version lacks Life Vulnerability; the spear deals physical damage only
item.logos_dimension.ancient_embrace.des: Block to light leaves. Lower at five leaves: 5 mana restores 4 health. Well-timed blocks light two leaves.
tooltip.logos_dimension.longsword.charge: Hold Use to charge upright; release for an overhead cut
tooltip.logos_dimension.blacksteel_longs: Use: hold the blade upright to block; a mana shield stops attacks and spells from the front, costing mana instead of durability; void passes through
Mana wraps cast with it, and what they set off: 30% cheaper, 30% more damage
While blocking, Attack to charge; release Use once full to cast
tooltip.logos_dimension.uchigatana.guard: Hold Use to guard instantly; a hit right as you guard is parried, then Attack to thrust
tooltip.logos_dimension.ryuka.mana: A blade of condensed mana: holding it costs 1 mana per second, each swing 10
tooltip.logos_dimension.ryuka.combo: Attack: five-hit combo; the finisher releases a cherry-blossom wave (30 more mana)
tooltip.logos_dimension.ryuka.guard: Hold Use to guard instantly; a hit within 0.5 s of guarding is parried, then Attack to thrust
tooltip.logos_dimension.ryuka.ward: The guard is a mana shield: blocks cost mana and stop magic too; parrying an axe is free, blocking one costs more, and only an empty pool breaks the guard
tooltip.logos_dimension.ryuka.marks: Each hit leaves a foxfire mark; five burst for heavy foxfire damage and leave the target open to execution for 8 seconds
tooltip.logos_dimension.ryuka.stance: While guarding, hold Attack for the hira-ichimonji stance; release to dash and cut upward: launches, or executes a target whose marks just burst (tap Attack)
tooltip.logos_dimension.ryuka.blade: Deals only arcane damage and passes through shields; foes it slays scatter as petals
tooltip.logos_dimension.yumi.draw: Hold Use: nock, raise the bow overhead, then draw to full; release to shoot
tooltip.logos_dimension.yumi.arrow: Fast, hard-hitting arrows; letting go while raising does not shoot
tooltip.logos_dimension.oath_spear.combo: Attack: thrust, sweep, overhand stab and rising launch (can be held); the launch throws targets into the air
tooltip.logos_dimension.oath_spear.flurr: Hold Use: eight rapid thrusts a second, double damage and longer air time on launched targets; after about three seconds, spin and slam them down
message.logos_dimension.railgun.mana: Not enough mana to flick the coin: needs %s, have %s
tooltip.logos_dimension.wallet.use: Use to open · click coins onto it in the inventory to deposit
screen.logos_dimension.fx.no_data: No quotes yet; wait for the changer to open
screen.logos_dimension.wallet.unlocked: May be auto-exchanged when short at checkout
message.logos_dimension.fx.too_far: Too far from the exchange counter
message.logos_dimension.fx.closed: The money changer has closed; opens at 6:00
message.logos_dimension.fx.too_small: Too small to get a single coin
fx.news.festival.notice: The fox sanctuary posts a notice: Foxfire Festival in two days
fx.news.festival.start: Foxfire Festival opens; traders scramble for fox coin (+%s%%)
fx.news.mint.rumor.up: Rumor: the imperial mint will strike a flood of new coin
fx.news.mint.rumor.down: Rumor: the empire will recall debased coin and tighten
fx.news.mint.up: The empire mints new coin; imperial weakens (all +%s%%)
fx.news.mint.down: The empire recalls debased coin; imperial strengthens (all -%s%%)
fx.news.mint.fake: The imperial mint denies any change
fx.news.calamity.rumor: Word of great monster unrest at the border
fx.news.calamity.real: A monster tide strikes; money flees to fox coin, cat coin slips (fox +%s%%)
fx.news.calamity.fake: The border unrest was a false alarm
fx.news.council.rumor.up: Hearsay: the cat council will pass the trade act
fx.news.council.rumor.down: Hearsay: the cat council will reject the trade act
fx.news.council.up: Cat council passes the trade act; cat coin rises (+%s%%)
fx.news.council.down: Cat council rejects the trade act; cat coin falls (-%s%%)
fx.news.council.fake: The cat council never voted on the trade act
fx.news.war.rumor.up: News from the front: the wolves have the upper hand
fx.news.war.rumor.down: News from the front: the wolves are falling back
fx.news.war.up: The wolves win; wolf coin soars (+%s%%)
fx.news.war.down: The wolves lose; wolf coin plunges (-%s%%)
fx.news.war.fake: The war at the front was only rumor
fx.news.harvest.up: %s lands bring in a fine harvest (+%s%%)
fx.news.milestone.fox_sanctuary: The fox sanctuary opens trade with the world; fox coin gains
screen.logos_dimension.bank.will_borrow: Short of funds; the bank lends the rest
message.logos_dimension.bank.in_debt: You owe the bank; loans cannot be withdrawn
message.logos_dimension.bank.bad_stop: Stop must be on the losing side, take on the winning side
message.logos_dimension.dawnvow.unmoved: The sword will not move. The light on it is still too faint…
message.logos_dimension.dawnvow.drawn: %s drew Dawnvow from the stone at daybreak.
message.logos_dimension.dawnvow.mana: The grand charge needs %s mana; you ran out (%s left)
screen.logos_dimension.bank.limit_note: Fills at the price; margin is held now
screen.logos_dimension.bank.order_note: Fills during market hours; cancelling refunds to the bank
screen.logos_dimension.bank.pick: Click a row on the left to manage it
bank.notice.warning: %s%s is down to half its margin; liquidation at %s silver
bank.notice.sell: Order filled: sold %s %s for %s crowns, banked
bank.notice.unfilled: %s%s order not filled (too many positions); margin refunded
message.logos_dimension.bank.offline: While you were away the bank posted %s notices:
message.logos_dimension.bank.cancelled: Order cancelled; funds returned to the bank
screen.logos_dimension.fx.limit_imperial: Limit orders need imperial on one side
message.logos_dimension.bank.too_deep: Too large for the market; split it up
bank.notice.voided: %s%s exceeded market depth (an old-version bug); voided and margin refunded
block.logos_dimension.journey_omikuji_bo: You already drew a fortune today
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.1: Dawn rose before you and is waiting at your door.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.2: What you seek is within reach. Remember to say thanks.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.3: Set out for far shores. New ground will repay each step.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.4: The furnace burns true. What you start now will come out well.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.5: Fair wind in your sails. Still, keep an eye out for rocks.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.6: A fox tail brushed your shoulder. Walk on, and do not look back.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse.7: Speak the thing you have held back. An answer is ready for it.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.1: The clouds part after noon. No need to rush out the door.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.2: A fellow traveler is coming. Slow your pace a little.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.3: Your seed has taken root. Stop digging it up to check.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.4: A boat waits at the ferry. Better on time than early.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.5: One more careful pass, and the work will begin to shine.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.6: Far from home, ask the way. Someone will point you right.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse.7: Past the halfway mark the view improves. Do not rest too long.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.1: The tea is warm enough. Leave the coals alone.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.2: No wind, no rain. A fine day to mend the fence.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.3: Pick up what you set aside. It still has some use in it.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.4: Little lost, enough gained. Let that be plenty.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.5: A neighbor's idle word may answer a small question.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.6: Eat while it is hot, walk without hurry, and all stays well.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse.7: Settle your accounts by sundown and you will sleep sound.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.1: Mind your step, and that is one fall you will not take.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.2: Check your deep pockets. A forgotten coin may be hiding there.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.3: A swallow returns to the eaves. Small news, but glad news.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.4: Read the vial's label twice and spare yourself a fright.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.5: This morning's porridge tastes better. Do not gulp it.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.6: The wayside berries have ripened just in time.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse.7: A small greeting buys you half a day of good cheer.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.1: The bud is still shut. It is waiting on an east wind.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.2: The tide is going out. When it turns, it turns for you.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.3: The wine is still in the cellar. Too soon to break the seal.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.4: The night road ends soon. The lamp is over the next hill.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.5: What slips away today will find you again further on.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.6: Your letter is on its way. It simply walks slowly.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse.7: The fox has written down your name. Another day, then.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.1: Pick no quarrels today. Even a win would cost you.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.2: This slip weighs on the hand. Tie it up and go home light.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.3: Keep off night roads, and beware the too-sweet smile.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.4: A crack runs through your flask. Find it before it finds you.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.5: Loose talk brings trouble. Tie this up and walk home quiet.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.6: Leave the ill omen here. The fox will watch it for you.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse.7: The bridge planks are rotten. The long way still gets you home.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.1: Black clouds overhead. Stop everything, and tie this slip first.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.2: Your lamp runs low. Turn back now, while the way is still clear.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.3: The shadow at your door is not your own. Bar it before dark.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.4: Do not carry this down the hill. Leave it on the rack and walk free.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.5: All you lean on will give way today. Only caution holds.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.6: Snow has shut the pass. Sit out the day; there is still tomorrow.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse.7: Ill luck knows your face. Tie this up, and take another road.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.0: Buyers wait at your door before the goods are out.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.1: A far-sailing ship returns with its holds full.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.2: Copper knocks first; the gold crown follows.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.4: Name your price; leave room for those who return.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.5: What you stored turns to gold in one morning.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.6: The fox checked your abacus; every bead runs true.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus2.7: Wealth comes in like a tide; mind your banks.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.0: A small purse, walked slowly, still arrives.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.1: Keep asking; a fair price waits at the last stall.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.2: Each coin in the box rings a small, good note.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.3: A buyer wavers; pour them one more cup of tea.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.4: A letter from afar may carry modest custom.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.5: Little gained, save a customer worth keeping.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.6: Keep the scales level, and trade keeps steady.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.plus1.7: Old wares, made fresh, can still fetch a koban.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.0: Cheap goods are cheap for a reason.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.1: Read the partner's contract once more.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.2: Mend the hole in your purse before you walk on.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.3: The market lies in fog. Wait until it lifts.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.4: Coin lent out may be slow to find its way home.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.5: Grasp at a penny and lose the sale.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.6: Ships run late; goods may land out of season.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus1.7: Behind that smile, an abacus is clicking.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.0: Gold falls like leaves when the autumn wind blows.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.1: The rats in your store grow fat. Count it all now.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.2: Thieves line this road. Keep your gold from sight.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.3: Rich promises are bait upon a hook.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.4: Dreams of alchemic gold wake to cold ash.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.5: Sign today, and you will rue it for many a day.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.6: The loss is sure. Let some go to save the rest.
luck.logos_dimension.wealth.minus2.7: Your capital thins. Shut shop; the tide may turn.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.0: The tide is rising. Your boat need only cast off.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.1: A fox tail brushes the scale; it tips your way.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.2: The tavern talk holds true. Keep it to yourself.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.3: Bare boughs are budding. The keen cut one early.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.4: The ink is still wet, and luck is on the page.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.5: Fine horse, open road. Keep hold of the reins.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.6: Coin rings sweet. Take it, and know when to stop.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus2.7: The geese keep faith. Good word is on its way.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.0: A crack in the cloud, enough to read the sky.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.1: Cross by small steps; each stone will hold.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.2: The rumor rings true. Ask one more to be sure.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.3: Kind fortune waits at the exchange. Go early.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.4: The wind warms; swallows under the eaves know.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.5: Ripe fruit will fall. Wait beneath the bough.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.6: Bear the quiet a while, and an echo will come.
luck.logos_dimension.market.plus1.7: Those with tidy ledgers find small gains.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.0: Fog on the ford. Board no boat blind.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.1: Gossip clings like down and is slow to shake off.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.2: The hare you chase runs for the thorns.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.3: The door all crowd toward is the narrowest.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.4: The scale sits a little off. Look twice.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.5: The notice reads calm. Mind what lies behind it.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.6: A draft in the purse. Tie it tight first.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus1.7: No lantern on the night road. Best head home.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.0: Ants in the dike. Leave before the water rises.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.1: Sweet talk fills the lane, every word a hook.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.2: High towers, hard winds. Climb now and regret it.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.3: Gold in a mirror shatters at the touch.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.4: Thin ice. Do not covet the lights across.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.5: Ink spills over all. Only idle hands stay clean.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.6: The ledgers are shut. Ask no prices today.
luck.logos_dimension.market.minus2.7: A flood comes. Drop the load; fish another day.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.0: One arrow at dawn scatters many. Chase none.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.1: Fair wind, true string; every way lies open.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.2: Where the spear points, gates swing wide.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.3: Foxfire leads; night battles are clear as day.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.4: Victory runs like a tide. Stop at its crest.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.5: A strong foe before you: your name awaits.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.6: Gain one step early; the rest come at ease.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus2.7: The sword hums in its case. Draw, without pride.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.0: Hold steady; the gap will show itself.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.1: Guard first; the counter will come to hand.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.2: Slightly off, the arrow still finds its mark.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.3: Old wounds have closed. Keep that old rematch.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.4: Go with company; someone will catch your fall.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.5: Small wins gather. No need for one great blow.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.6: Whet the blade tonight; tomorrow it bites.
luck.logos_dimension.war.plus1.7: Many foes, one loose will. Strike their leader.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.0: Your straps work loose. Tie them once more.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.1: Nothing is settled yet; stake nothing on it.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.2: A moment's daring, a long look back.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.3: The ground favors them. Step back and look.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.4: The edge has turned. Trust not its old bite.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.5: Your rival hides their skill. Doubt that stumble.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.6: Mist on the road; it may be hiding blades.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus1.7: They goad you with words. Do not answer.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.0: The blade breaks on the road. Turn home at once.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.1: Black clouds loom. Who retreats stays whole.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.2: One urge to win, and the whole board is lost.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.3: The fox covers its eyes. Do not fight today.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.4: An abyss ahead, the road behind. Turn and live.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.5: String snapped, arrow fallen; they will laugh.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.6: Not a foe for today. Save your life for later.
luck.logos_dimension.war.minus2.7: To yield is no shame. To die for pride is folly.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.0: One lamplit thought unties every old knot.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.1: The rune flows from your pen. Do not boast of it.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.2: The page that long resisted opens tonight.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.3: The wand obeys like your own arm.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.4: No teacher beside you, yet the way is in hand.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.5: The fox turns the page for you. Read on.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.6: Your chant begins, and the very walls answer.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus2.7: Insight wells like a spring. Drink, do not drown.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.0: Patient ink finds the door, little by little.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.1: Even a torn page has something to teach.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.2: Small workings first; greater ones will follow.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.3: Ask the novice too. Answers hide in odd places.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.4: Check it once more; the flaw will show itself.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.5: Read a little late; morning brings understanding.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.6: A faint glow at the wand's tip. Follow it.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.plus1.7: Your old notes hold a new answer.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.0: One stray stroke can ruin a page. Take care.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.1: A restless mind cannot enter a book. Sit first.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.2: Half-understood is the most dangerous kind.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.3: The words slip mid-chant. Go over them again.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.4: Better one page digested than ten swallowed.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.5: The wand sits heavy. Do not force it.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.6: Copied workings seldom serve the copyist.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus1.7: Tired eyes read poorly. Better to rest early.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.0: You know every word, and no sentence makes sense.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.1: Spells turn on their makers. Try nothing new.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.2: Each correction breeds two. Put down the pen.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.3: The chant will not come. Do not strain for it.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.4: What feels like insight is a wrong turn.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.5: Ink on the scroll. Recopy it; all is not lost.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.6: The book has closed itself. Ask nothing today.
luck.logos_dimension.spell.minus2.7: The tunnel ends here. Turn back and ask for help.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.0: One seed sown, a thousand come home.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.1: Gold rolls the rows; scent outruns the sickle.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.2: Rain knows its hour. Just get the seed in.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.3: Vines hang heavy with jewels; bring more baskets.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.4: Where the fox has trod, no weed takes root.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.5: Full barns are foretold. Keep back the seed.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.6: The earth runs strong; even dead wood buds.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus2.7: Reap briskly; even bounty fears the night rain.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.0: Even rows, strong shoots. The hoe is repaid.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.1: Spirit shoots are waking; tend them gently.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.2: A little to spare; share a measure next door.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.3: Dew on the leaf favors the early riser.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.4: The berries redden. A few days' patience yet.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.5: Turn the old rows; the soil will answer.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.6: No great year, but the table will be full.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.plus1.7: Sparrows come and go, taking but a few grains.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus1.0: Better a day of sky-watching than an early sowing.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus1.1: Thin soil. Feed the ground before asking of it.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus1.2: Pests hide under the leaf. Turn it and look.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus1.3: Crowd the field and every shoot goes thin.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus1.4: Heavy clouds, no rain. Carry the water yourself.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus1.5: Picked in haste, the fruit stays sour.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus1.6: Mend the fence before you count the crop.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus1.7: Empty ears stand tallest. Don't be fooled.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus2.0: Frost keeps no calendar; the tender die first.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus2.1: The land is spent. Rest it, and it will return.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus2.2: The field cracks like a turtle's back. Dig deep.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus2.3: Rats in the granary. Guard what you have.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus2.4: Vine withered, trellis down. Accept this one.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus2.5: Seeds sleep and will not wake. Waste no more.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus2.6: Locusts blot the sun. Save what sheaves you can.
luck.logos_dimension.harvest.minus2.7: The fox shakes its head. Do not fight the sky.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus2.0: The fire obeys; nothing in your hands is wasted.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus2.1: The first flask sweetens the room. Unseal slowly.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus2.2: The recipe that failed you now answers your call.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus2.3: Gold sleeps in the stone; one firing wakes it.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus2.4: Your hands run ahead, and your heart keeps pace.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus2.5: The fox watches you light the kiln. Work freely.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus2.6: Each drop falls as wished. Just do not be greedy.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus2.7: Fine materials come unbidden. Treat them kindly.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus1.0: Low flame beats high. Stay with it and it comes.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus1.1: Start small; the great piece can wait.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus1.2: Stir once less, and the brew runs deeper.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus1.3: The old tool is dull, yet it still serves.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus1.4: Life stirs in the flask. Stop lifting the lid.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus1.5: A passerby's idle question may open a door.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus1.6: Steady hands; let the hours do the rest.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.plus1.7: The ashes still hold heat. Add one more stick.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus1.0: Hot fire, hot temper. Bank it and come back.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus1.1: One spoon astray sours the pot. Measure twice.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus1.2: Blame no murk in a flask you did not rinse.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus1.3: Haste walks the same road twice.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus1.4: Today's clever idea may shame you. Note it; wait.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus1.5: Clumsy fingers. Sharpen tools; leave the fire.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus1.6: The wind keeps turning. Keep the kiln door shut.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus1.7: Your stock runs low. Do not stake it all.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus2.0: The pot cracks at the last. Stand well back.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus2.1: Cold kiln, flying ash. No hour to light it.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus2.2: All you refine is dross; all you spend is gone.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus2.3: Flask broken, brew spilled. Only sweeping is left.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus2.4: Each patch springs a leak. Put down your tools.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus2.5: The fox leaves, nose covered. Let the fire rest.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus2.6: This work is lost. Keep the notes for another day.
luck.logos_dimension.alchemy.minus2.7: Black smoke in the rafters. Shut it; await dawn.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus2.0: The mist lifts first; the road lies open.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus2.1: Through a thousand gates, unseen hands lead.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus2.2: Wind at your back; moonlight for the return.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus2.3: Far water yields; a crossing waits for you.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus2.4: Deep woods, no straying. Birdsong guides you.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus2.5: Far lands feel next door. Still, pack food.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus2.6: Foxfire goes ahead. Even night roads are kind.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus2.7: Set out light, come home laden.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus1.0: The small path beats the great. Take it.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus1.1: The wind turns past noon; catch the next leg.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus1.2: Steep hill, good steps. Climb and you arrive.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus1.3: Village lamps draw near; a bed can be had.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus1.4: Rain comes late. You will reach the eaves.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus1.5: Meet a stream, follow it. Water knows.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus1.6: New flowers on an old road. Spare a look.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.plus1.7: Ask the way and be answered kindly.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus1.0: Mist at mid-slope. Turn back early.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus1.1: Wind at the ferry. Wait for the next tide.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus1.2: Shortcuts fork and fork. Keep the old road.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus1.3: Wet boots, dim road. Do not hurry off.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus1.4: Leave this late and you may miss your bed.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus1.5: A fork you seem to know. Mark it anyway.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus1.6: Too much baggage. Drop one thing, go farther.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus1.7: Rotting planks ahead. Test before you step.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus2.0: Go no farther than the shrine gate.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus2.1: The peak shelters no one. Thunder stirs.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus2.2: Floods take the road. Turn back while you can.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus2.3: Night fog eats the trail. Farther, more lost.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus2.4: A kind wind near a cliff is no friend.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus2.5: The way home is hidden. Rest by the near fire.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus2.6: No chimney smoke that way. Do not go alone.
luck.logos_dimension.travel.minus2.7: The box gives no answer. Stay home.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus2.0: What you lost is already on its way back.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus2.1: Foxfire still marks last night's road.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus2.2: Your purse fills again. Mind the knot this time.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus2.3: Ask no one. Someone is already bringing it.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus2.4: The old thing returns, and brings a friend.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus2.5: Turn back three paces; it glints in the dust.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus2.6: The wind took it not far. Stoop, and it is yours.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus2.7: A fox left it on your step. Do say thanks.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus1.0: Ask slowly. Word will come before the full moon.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus1.1: It has not forsaken you. It is only late.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus1.2: Far roads keep old things well. Be patient.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus1.3: Empty every pocket. The last may answer.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus1.4: Walk the old road again. Watch the grass.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus1.5: When the snow melts, the stone shows. Do not dig.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus1.6: Stop searching, and it turns up.
luck.logos_dimension.lost.plus1.7: A stranger may know. Ask once more at each inn.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus2.0: A far guest draws near. Sweep the path.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus2.1: One long parted is already homeward.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus2.2: A stranger on the road proves an old friend.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus2.3: Magpies chatter at the eaves. Stay and wait.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus2.4: Leave a lamp lit. A knock comes by midnight.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus2.5: A bond is ready to tie. Only speak true.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus2.6: Old grudges thaw. One smile will do it.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus2.7: A fox tail leads to kind faces. Give thanks.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus1.0: Late, perhaps, yet the promise will be kept.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus1.1: Word arrives first; the sender soon follows.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus1.2: Reheat the tea once; the guest will be there.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus1.3: Share a stretch of road; gain good company.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus1.4: Speak first, and be first to make a friend.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus1.5: A small quarrel fades by morning.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus1.6: Bow to strange faces in the woods; all is well.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.plus1.7: Not the one awaited, yet welcome all the same.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus1.0: The date may slip. Do not haunt the doorway.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus1.1: Swallow a third of what you mean to say.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus1.2: A kind face, an unread heart.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus1.3: Waiting yields nothing. Go and seek them.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus1.4: You go east, they go west. The road parts you.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus1.5: Ask no favors; it would sour the peace.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus1.6: Hear the gossip, then let it go.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus1.7: Wary eyes watch the deep wood. Do not trespass.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus2.0: None comes. Only leaves gather at the door.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus2.1: One wrong word bares blades. Withdraw at once.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus2.2: Old friends turn. Past words return as thorns.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus2.3: The one at the door means ill. Do not answer.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus2.4: Ask no names on the night road. Walk on.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus2.5: A feud is born today; only a bowed head ends it.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus2.6: No word will come. Stop waiting and go home.
luck.logos_dimension.meeting.minus2.7: A shadow trails you. Keep to open roads.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikichi.verse: The fox smiles on every road you take today.
fortune.logos_dimension.chukichi.verse: Good winds; keep walking and they will find you.
fortune.logos_dimension.kichi.verse: A quiet day that ends better than it began.
fortune.logos_dimension.shokichi.verse: Small luck, for those who notice small things.
fortune.logos_dimension.suekichi.verse: Not today. But the road turns ahead.
fortune.logos_dimension.kyo.verse: Tie this paper to the rack and leave it behind.
fortune.logos_dimension.daikyo.verse: Even the foxes look away. Tie it up, quickly.
